note: Check and probe codes -> WCAG SC and failure pattern (patterns and default severities come from data/wcag-sc.json). kind: failure (a candidate for a finding), advisory (platform guideline, never a failure), review (needs a person). Android checks are this skill's own, run on the uiautomator hierarchy and screenshot; Google's Accessibility Test Framework and Xcode's accessibility audit map in the same way when they run.

label.control-no-name.what: A clickable element with no text, content description or labelled descendant

label.icon-button-no-name.what: An icon-only control (no text descendants) with no content description

target.below-24dp.what: A clickable element smaller than 24 x 24 dp with no 24 dp spacing to its neighbours

target.below-48dp.what: Below the Android 48 x 48 dp guideline (WCAG passes at 24 dp)

contrast.text.what: Text below 4.5:1 (3:1 at 18.5 dp bold or 24 dp) against its background, measured from screenshot pixels

contrast.text-dark.what: The same, with the system dark theme on

text-scale.not-enlarged.what: At font scale 2.0 a text element keeps its height while the rest grows: text is clipped or cut to one line

display-size.offscreen.what: At the largest display size a control or text ends up off screen or overlapping another

orientation.locked.what: The screen stays portrait when the device is rotated with auto-rotate off and landscape requested

keyboard.trap.what: Tab does not move focus and Escape or Back does not leave

keyboard.unreachable.what: A clickable control never receives focus with Tab

motion.auto-advance.what: Content changes by itself between screenshots 5 s and 7.5 s apart, with no pause, stop or hide control on the screen

heading.not-exposed.what: uiautomator does not expose headings; check heading semantics with TalkBack or source

android.name: mobile-checks
android.role: the skill's own checks on the hierarchy and screenshot

not_applicable_software.note: EN 301 549 clause 11 marks these web criteria as not applicable to non-web software (they rely on sets of web pages).
